Compliance Is Easy to Forget — Until It's Too Late

Certificates buried in inboxes. Expiry dates lost in spreadsheets. No clear overview across properties.

When documentation is scattered, visibility disappears — and deadlines get missed.

Compliance Vault Pro gives you structured oversight so nothing critical slips through.

Check Your Compliance Risk
All Your Compliance Tracking in One Structured Dashboard

Track evidence, see risk indicators, get reminders, and generate reports. No legal claims — just structured tracking.

Track evidence and expiries

Securely store Gas Safety (CP12), EICR, EPC, HMO licences and supporting documents. Track issue and expiry dates in one organised portal.

Compliance score (risk indicator)

See a clear risk indicator per property and across your portfolio based on evidence and expiry status. Transparency over what’s valid, expiring, or missing.

Reminders

Receive email and SMS reminders before deadlines (plan-based) so you can renew in good time.

Reports and exports

Generate structured PDF and CSV reports (plan-based) for internal reviews or professional consultation.

Built for Modern UK Landlords

Works for solo landlords, portfolio landlords, and HMO operators. Also suitable for managing agents overseeing landlord portfolios.

Solo landlords

Keep your compliance documentation organised and monitored from day one.

Portfolio landlords

Track multiple properties with structured oversight and centralised reporting.

HMO / managed properties

Monitor licensing, renewals, and property-level documentation clearly.
